title: EduPlan: choose the visual world for the whole app
question: The roll assigned « Le Bulletin ». Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Sketches show the teacher home (Accueil).

options.label: Le Bulletin
options.lineage: The French bulletin trimestriel: matière, coef, moyenne, appréciation, conseil de classe
options.thesis: Every grade, absence and assignment shows where it lands on the term report.
materials: flat ink-green rail on a green-tinted ground
white rounded modules, tabular figures, function tints
options.viewport: Green rail; top bar with a trimestre ribbon (week 8 of 12, conseil de classe date); Aujourd'hui slots with the open register; À corriger; a Mes classes table in bulletin columns showing grades entered vs expected.
options.risk: Grades in correction red can be mistaken for an error state; critical states must use shape and amber, never red alone.

raised.raise: One tonal ramp: every neutral comes from a single 10-step ramp tinted from the rail green; no ad-hoc greys.
Flat colour fields: rail and function tints are flat, with no gradients and no glows.
Destructive actions (supprimer un devoir, effacer une note) sit apart and stay outlined until focused.
Prose holds a 65-character measure: instructions and appréciations never run full width.
Urgency on one fixed ramp: en retard, aujourd'hui, à venir carried by weight and order, not new colours.

options.label: Le Carnet de correspondance
options.lineage: The school-family liaison booklet, signed « vu » by the parent
options.thesis: Every item travels teacher to student to family, and shows who has seen it.
materials: a three-step « vu » chain on every post, grade and absence
options.viewport: Teal rail; Aujourd'hui slots; a liaison column where each post shows Envoyé · Vu par l'élève · Vu par la famille; families who have not seen an absence surface first.
options.risk: Puts the parent loop first, so the grading workload sits lower on the teacher home.

options.label: Le Tableau du jour
options.lineage: Boarding pass and gate board, fused with the school day
options.thesis: Today's courses as a live board: ranked by time, a changed room or replacement stays lit until seen.
materials: segmented course passes (classe, salle, heure, appel)
options.viewport: Top bar; a full-width board of today's slots with the current one lit and a changed room held in amber; À corriger and classes below.
options.case: Strong product clarity for the phone-first register; weaker audience identification, since nothing in it reads as school.
options.risk: Reads as a transport app if the board grammar spreads beyond the home.

options.label: Exposure record
options.viewport: Overlapping sheets over a zone wedge.
options.case: Loses both axes: teachers do not know darkrooms, and hatching hides grades.
options.risk: Technical costume on a friendly brief.
options.kept: One tonal ramp as the only neutral tokens.

options.label: Zoo guide map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.case: Loses both axes: lobes fight dense tables and the class list.
options.risk: Playful to the point of childish for secondary school.
options.kept: Flat colour fields with no gradients.

options.label: Dark developer console
options.thesis: Graphite panels split by hairline seams.
options.case: Loses both axes: dark and technical, against a pinned light, friendly brief.
options.risk: Cold enterprise feel the brief refuses.

options.label: Centre-rail reference
options.lineage: Wide-margin edition with a key rail
options.thesis: Twin text columns around a rail of keys.
options.viewport: Small text block in a wide margin.
options.case: Loses both axes: a reading form, and no radius against a rounded brief.

options.label: Star atlas
options.thesis: Importance as dot magnitude on a dark sky.
options.case: Loses both axes: dark ground, and no school reading.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Google Classroom and Toddle played straight: class cards with colour banners and a To-do column.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar; a grid of class cards with banners; a To-do column on the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the tools teachers already know, by design.
